race.comment: EARLY CROW EVANS (8) was strongly fancied last time and hit the ground running with a slick early split, giving a sight but could manage only third (24.02) at Bendigo over 425m. Top chance in this line up. ODDLY COOL (7) is an honest type in the frame at 11 of 31 starts including 11 wins, the latest scoring (16.82) over 300m at this track. Form here sound including three wins. Rates a winning chance on best. BRIMSON BANNER (5) boasts a consistent overall record including 10 wins from 32 starts, the latest winning (16.79) over 300m at this track. Super consistent and can feature with the right run. ZIPPING TESFAY (2) warrants respect with the drop in trip.
